name: Fleck
description: Radius shrunk to confetti: small discs parked on one of nine positions in the cell, at three sizes, so the field speckles instead of tiling.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; @size: @pick(30%, 46%, 62%); left: @pick(6%, 30%, 54%); top: @pick(6%, 30%, 54%); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
